remarks: Welcome to this beautiful 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom corner unit in The Biltmore one of Stamford's premier full-service luxury buildings. Spanning 1,038 square feet, this light-filled residence boasts an open layout with oversized windows that flood the space with natural sunlight throughout the day.  Thoughtfully updated, the unit offers a modern kitchen, spacious living and dining areas, and two well-appointed bathrooms. Both bedrooms are generously sized, with ample closet space and serene city views. The Biltmore elevates urban living with 24/7 concierge and doorman service, on-site maintenance, a fully equipped fitness center, residents' game room, landscaped outdoor terrace with dog park, secured garage parking, and private storage. Unbeatable downtown location just steps from Stamford Town Center, top-rated restaurants, boutique shops, corporate offices, and Metro-North/Amtrak trains for an effortless commute to NYC and beyond. Experience the best of city living in a building that has it all.
